## Verification

- [ ] `npm run validate-registry`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build` (when frontend/config changed)
- [ ] Playwright E2E (when user flow/UI changed)
- [ ] API smoke/security checks (when backend changed)

## Formula-specific checklist (if applicable)

- [ ] Formula has bilingual name, category, LaTeX, variable domains/units, and outputs.
- [ ] At least four independently verifiable automated test cases are included.
- [ ] Step-by-step output, limitations, and references are documented.
- [ ] Catalog/registry index is synchronized; no `eval`, `exec`, or dynamic source execution.

## UI/accessibility checklist (if applicable)

- [ ] Keyboard, screen-reader labels/live regions, RTL/LTR, reduced motion, and touch targets reviewed.
- [ ] Mobile/desktop behavior checked; screenshots attached when available.

## Release and security notes

- [ ] Docs/CHANGELOG/ROADMAP updated where needed.
- [ ] No secrets, generated build output, or user data added.
- [ ] Breaking changes and deployment/rollback impact documented.
